newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs three pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs three pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 2.18 points or 2.97 percent at 75.52 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index ended 2.58 points or 0.1 percent higher at a provisional 3,405.18.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 15.05 percent from Thursday's 13.12 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
